items.query: How well does Cyberpunk 2077 run on PC these days?
items.source_text:
Probably in my top five favorite games of all time. I've played through this game over 5 times on my Xbox One and finally got a pc a few days ago and- WHEW! what a difference! like playing the game for the first time all over again! (except without crashing at the end of the prologue this time haha!)

I had always seen videos of the newer updates but i never quite understood just how different it really is. The game is also beautiful on what from I understand is a relatively outdated pc. It really puts Xbox to shame. It makes me sad that I wasted so many years playing an inferior version of what my dream game has always been!
items.candidate_statement_zh: 评论者从 Xbox One 转到 PC 后，这次游玩没有再次遇到序章结尾的崩溃。

items.query: How is the asymmetric gameplay in Resident Evil Resistance?
items.source_text:
Resident Evil Resistance is a really promising concept ! Taking the asymmetrical multiplayer idea of Dead by Daylight and putting it in the Resident Evil universe was such a cool move! The atmosphere, characters, and setting fit perfectly with this kind of gameplay.

...

That said, there are some downsides that really hurt the experience : long waiting times to find a match, a pretty limited map selection ; and maybe less of a dealbreaker but still noticeable : unbalanced teams. It can make matches feel a bit... chaotic, to say the least.

items.query: What technical problems ruin RollerCoaster Tycoon World?
items.source_text: This is truly the WORST game I've ever played. This game is so horribly optimized, it constantly freezes, and or crashes. I only bought it while it was on sale for $4 because I've heard the bad reviews. It's honestly tragic to see how far RollerCoaster Tycoon has fallen. Do yourself a favor and stay away form this game! Buy Planet Coaster, or any of the 1-3 installments of the original RollerCoaster Tycoon games.

items.query: What technical problems ruin RollerCoaster Tycoon World?
items.source_text: Rollercoaster tycoon world is a terrible amusement park management game, however, it is a decent rollercoaster building game. The controls are glitchy and horrible, the buildings dont align properly, and the paths are stupid. The new rollercoaster building tools are useful to some and are definitely a benifit, but, they are shadowed due how bad the 'usual' controls can be used. The graphics are decent as is the framerate (100+ fps pretty much constantly) The peeps look like ♥♥♥♥ tough. In my opinion Planet coaster and the previous RCT are far surperior in every aspect (espicially Planet coaster). If you like Park management games as much as i do then this game could be worth the $5NZL price, but, you'll only get a few hours gameplay max.

items.query: What technical problems ruin RollerCoaster Tycoon World?
items.source_text:

items.query: What bugs and glitches do players run into in Call of Duty: Warzone?
items.source_text:
Warzone is an absolute joke at this point. The servers are some of the worst I've ever seen in a major online game. Constant lag, packet bursts, desync, random disconnects, and getting killed around corners make every match feel broken. It doesn't matter how good your aim or positioning is when the servers decide who wins the fight.

What's even worse is the endless plague of cheaters. Every other match seems to have someone with suspicious tracking, wallhacks, or blatant aimbotting. It's beyond frustrating to spend 20 minutes looting and fighting just to get wiped by someone who clearly isn't playing legitimately. The anti-cheat system feels completely ineffective.

items.query: What bugs and glitches do players run into in Call of Duty: Warzone?
items.source_text: This game is cheeks. Glitches that never seem to get fixed and cheaters galore. Would be great to filter out input type since controller AA is so ridiculously OP. I've sunk a fair amount of time into WZ, DMZ and MP and have since uninstalled. The final straw was getting matched with a cheater from a previous resurgence game, who I blocked and reported, pulling the same crap two games later- sniping people through walls with no LoS, no scoping parachuters out of the air, infinite airstrikes. But hey, at least they'll ban your comms for 14 days when you call out the cheaters.

items.query: What makes Left 4 Dead 2 so replayable?
items.source_text:
Classic and a vital game to my childhood. Been playing since its release with Left 4 Dead.

First and foremost, the replayability of the game is oustanding. You can play the game numerous times and come back. Multiplayer is very good with its different game modes as well as the Versus Mode. Graphics is showing its age, however, it has so many details about everything that you never appreciate it but when you look you really start to see it. Overall a very nice game for everyone to play!

items.query: Which games have the most satisfying combat?
items.source_text:
I loved RE7. RE8, however, was massively overhyped. Thankfully, RE9 is a return to form.

Let's start with the positives.

+It looks great.
+Runs well and is properly optimised.
+Crunchier, more satisfying combat with much better weapon sounds.
+More memorable than RE8, with stronger writing.
+An overall far more enjoyable experience than RE8.

Now the negatives.

-Grace's voice acting gets annoying with her constant stammering.
-Leon's voice actor sounds bored at times, although I suppose that's just part of his badass persona?
-Nerfed dismemberment compared to previous games.
-Still no f*****g FOV slider. Seriously, Capcom?

Overall, RE9 is a massive improvement over RE8. Better combat, better presentation, better writing, and a much more memorable experience. It's not perfect, but Capcom cooked - mostly.

Found this review useful? Check out my curator. <URL>

items.query: What do players dislike about the driving and progression in Test Drive Unlimited Solar Crown?
items.source_text:
Played the game during free weekend. During that time the game had ups & downs. Overall this felt like most mid tier arcade car games, like NFS Heat & Crew 2. Worth buying if on sale I guess.
+ Cars sound very different from each other
+ Older cars actually feels like you are driving an old car
+ Driving over curbs can throw the car off balance easily
- Game does not punish you from crashing, infact it feels easiest way to win
- Could not find ANY players on online races, few seen in freeroam
- Game started feeling a bit repetitive after a while
- Takes a lot of time to unlock most cars & customizations (limited by player level)
- Too many races require specific stock car making upgrading semi useless
- Even tho you can repaint interior, there are NO visual tuning like spoilers (as far as I know)

What's even worse is the endless plague of cheaters. Every other match seems to have someone with suspicious tracking, wallhacks, or blatant aimbotting.
